pictures.scene: King David Kneeling before an Altar — the king on his knees at the altar wearing his crown, one hand laid on his breast and his harp set down beside him, a prayer of David, hear O LORD my righteous plea
pictures.name: pd_king_david_kneeling_before_an_altar

pictures.scene: El Greco, Saint Peter in Tears — the apostle with the keys at his belt and his hands clasped, weeping with his face turned up, listen to my cry, give ear to my prayer
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_saint_peter_in_tears

pictures.scene: Johannes Vermeer, Woman Holding a Balance — the woman watching the scales settle in the quiet light, it comes from lips free of deceit, may my vindication come from Your presence
pictures.name: pd_vermeer_balance

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Last Judgement — Christ enthroned in a blue mandorla with His hand raised, ringed by saints and angels, may Your eyes see what is right, You have tried my heart
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_the_last_judgement

pictures.scene: Ferdinand Bol, The Angel Appearing to Elijah — the angel standing over the worn-out prophet with the flask held out to him, You have visited me in the night, You have tested me and found no evil
pictures.name: pd_bol_the_angel_appearing_to_elijah

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, An Old Woman Reading, probably the Prophetess Anna — the light falling on the open page she loves, I have resolved not to sin with my mouth, as for the deeds of men
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_anna_reading

pictures.scene: Philippe de Champaigne, Moses Presenting the Tablets of the Law — the prophet holding out the two tablets so the words can be read, by the word of Your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent
pictures.name: pd_de_champaigne_moses_presenting_the_tablets_of_the_law

pictures.scene: Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, Le chemin de Sevres — the open road running out through the trees toward the distant town, my steps have held to Your paths, my feet have not slipped
pictures.name: pd_corot_road

pictures.scene: Nicolaes Maes, An Old Woman Praying — the old woman with her hands folded over the laid table and her eyes lifted, I call on You O God for You will answer me, incline Your ear to me
pictures.name: pd_maes_an_old_woman_praying

pictures.scene: Maurycy Gottlieb, Jews Praying in the Synagogue on Yom Kippur — the congregation standing shoulder to shoulder in their prayer shawls, hear my words, show the wonders of Your loving devotion
pictures.name: pd_gottlieb_jews_praying_on_yom_kippur

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, Jesus Walks on Water — the figure standing on the dark sea in a track of light, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_jesus_walks_on_water

pictures.scene: Andrea del Verrocchio, Tobias and the Angel — the angel walking beside the boy with a hand under his arm, the little dog at their heels and the fish in the boy's hand, keep me as the apple of Your eye, hide me in the shadow of Your wings
pictures.name: pd_verrocchio_tobias_and_the_angel

pictures.scene: Salvator Rosa, Bandits on a Rocky Coast — the armed men gathered on the rocks above the water at dusk, one seated with his sword while another points out along the shore, from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me
pictures.name: pd_rosa_bandits_on_a_rocky_coast

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Belshazzar's Feast — the king in his crown and heavy gold robes wrenching round from the laden table, they have closed their callous hearts, their mouths speak with arrogance
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_belshazzars_feast

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, The Death of the Stag — the stag brought down in the snow with the whole pack of hounds closed in around him, they have tracked us down and now surround us, their eyes are set to cast us to the ground
pictures.name: pd_courbet_hallali_van_het_hert

pictures.scene: Eugene Delacroix, Lion Devouring a Goat — the lion lying out in the open with its kill held down under its paws, like a lion greedy for prey, like a young lion lurking in ambush
pictures.name: pd_delacroix_lion_devouring_a_goat

pictures.scene: El Greco, Christ Driving the Money Changers from the Temple — Christ lifting the cord of whips over the traders in the temple court, arise O LORD confront them, bring them to their knees
pictures.name: pd_elgreco_money_changers

pictures.scene: Jacques Courtois, Joshua Defeating the Amalekites — the horsemen packed together in the thick of the fighting, deliver me from the wicked by Your sword, from such men O LORD by Your hand
pictures.name: pd_courtois_joshua_defeating_the_amalekites

pictures.scene: Hieronymus Bosch, Death and the Miser — the man in green still reaching into the money chest while the demons wait under it and the armor lies abandoned on the floor, from men of the world whose portion is in this life
pictures.name: pd_bosch_death_and_the_miser

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Harvesters — the reapers resting and eating under the tree beside the standing corn, may You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones and satisfy their sons
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_harvesters

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Jacob Blessing the Children of Joseph — the old man reaching his hand out to lay it on the child's head, so they leave their abundance to their children, and I will behold Your face in righteousness
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_jacob_blessing_the_children_of_joseph

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Transfiguration — Christ lifted up in white above the cloud with His arms open, when I awake I will be satisfied in Your presence
pictures.name: pd_raphael_the_transfiguration

lines.text: A prayer of David.
Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea;
listen to my cry.
Give ear to my prayer—
it comes from lips free of deceit.
May my vindication come from Your presence;
may Your eyes see what is right.
You have tried my heart;
You have visited me in the night.
You have tested me and found no evil;
I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.
As for the deeds of men—
by the word of Your lips
I have avoided the ways of the violent.
My steps have held to Your paths;
my feet have not slipped.
I call on You, O God, for You will answer me.
Incline Your ear to me;
hear my words.
Show the wonders of Your loving devotion,
You who save by Your right hand
those who seek refuge from their foes.
Keep me as the apple of Your eye;
hide me in the shadow of Your wings
from the wicked who assail me,
from my mortal enemies who surround me.
They have closed their callous hearts;
their mouths speak with arrogance.
They have tracked us down, and now surround us;
their eyes are set to cast us to the ground,
like a lion greedy for prey,
like a young lion lurking in ambush.
Arise, O LORD, confront them!
Bring them to their knees;
deliver me from the wicked by Your sword,
from such men, O LORD, by Your hand—
from men of the world
whose portion is in this life.
May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones
and satisfy their sons,
so they leave their abundance to their children.
As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness;
when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.
